name: Echo Protocol eBTC

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: A bare EOA holding every admin role (no multisig, no mint cap) was compromised on 2026-05-18 and minted 1,000 unbacked eBTC in one transaction - ~$76.6M notional, ~$816K realized after laundering. Not hypothetical: independently confirmed on-chain via the exact transaction.
narrative.tag: real, dated exploit - now on a 3-of-4 Safe
narrative.detail: This card shows the CURRENT state, not the incident-era one: within ~10 hours the key was rotated, through two hops, to a real 3-of-4 Gnosis Safe - confirmed live via hasRole()/getOwners()/getThreshold(), with both the original compromised EOA and the attacker address independently confirmed to no longer hold the admin role. MINTER_ROLE currently has no holder at all (minting is effectively paused). Composite reflects a genuine but recent, exploit-driven remediation - moderate, not high, since the rotation happened under active-exploit duress only 4 months before this pass.

cheapest_fix.what: admin power taken away from a bare key

independent_read.why: AccessControl (ERC-165) whose admin-role holders are not enumerable on-chain: read them from RoleGranted events; nothing for this reader to compare
